title: Concept: Build backend requirement with no version constraint
description: pyproject.toml declares a build requirement that names only the package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The build backend runs arbitrary code before the project is packaged, and an unpinned one pulls whatever the index serves.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: The build backend runs arbitrary code before the project is packaged, and an unpinned one pulls whatever the index serves.
